title: orion-verify: warn about a commands-table row the project's CLAUDE.md lacks, and offer to add it
summary: orion.sh verify now warns once for each required commands-table row a project's CLAUDE.md lacks, matching labels by one key word and skipping the table's header row, and /orion-verify proposes the missing row with the command's source, writing it only on a yes.

deferred.what: A project whose test-copies row is labelled without the word 'copies' (for example 'Pass the copy count to the full suite') gets a false missing-row warning on every verify until it accepts the rename.
deferred.why: Kept by the agreed one-key-word design.
